role.verboseLabel: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
role.label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
role.documentation: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

role.label: Asset Impairment Charges
role.documentation: Amount of write-down of assets recognized in the income statement. Includes, but is not limited to, losses from tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill.

role.terseLabel: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
role.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
role.documentation: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

role.terseLabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents
role.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents
role.documentation: Amount of cash and cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage. Excludes amount for disposal group and discontinued operations. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

role.totalLabel: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect, Total
role.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash, and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalents, and cash and cash equivalents restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits. Cash equivalents include, but are not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

role.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
role.documentation: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

role.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Paid

role.label: Entity [Domain]
role.documentation: All the names of the entities being reported upon in a document. Any legal structure used to conduct activities or to hold assets. Some examples of such structures are corporations, partnerships, limited liability companies, grantor trusts, and other trusts. This item does not include business and geographical segments which are included in the geographical or business segments domains.

role.label: Entity Listings, Exchange [Axis]
role.documentation: The axis of a table defines the relationship between the domain members or categories in the table and the line items or concepts that complete the table.

role.label: Fuel Reconciliation [Member]
role.documentation: Fuel Reconciliation

role.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
role.documentation: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fuel held in inventory.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

role.negatedLabel: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Regulatory Assets
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of other assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs to the balance sheet.

role.verboseLabel: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
role.documentation: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

role.label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Liabilities
role.documentation: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in regulated liabilities. Regulated liabilities are created when regulatory agency permits an entity to defer revenues to the balance sheet.

role.terseLabel: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
role.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

role.label: Intersegment Eliminations [Member]
role.documentation: Eliminating entries used in operating segment consolidation.

role.label: Legal Entity [Axis]
role.documentation: The set of legal entities associated with a report.

role.label: Litigation proceeds for reimbursement of spent nuclear fuel storage costs

role.totalLabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Total
role.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities, including discontinued operations. Financing activity cash flows include obtaining resources from owners and providing them with a return on, and a return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amounts borrowed, or settling the obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resources obtained from creditors on long-term credit.

role.verboseLabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities [Abstract]
role.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Total
role.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

role.verboseLabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities [Abstract]
role.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities [Abstract]

role.totalLabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Total
role.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

role.verboseLabel: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities [Abstract]
role.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities [Abstract]
Noncontrolling Interest [Member]
role.documentation: This element represents that portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent. A noncontrolling interest is sometimes called a minority interest.

role.label: Operating Segments [Member]
role.documentation: Identifies components of an entity that engage in business activities from which they may earn revenue and incur expenses, including transactions with other components of the same entity.

role.label: Opportunity Sales [Member]
role.documentation: Opportunity Sales [Member]

role.terseLabel: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
role.label: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
role.documentation: Other cash or noncash adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by (used in) operating activities that are not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows (for example, cash received or cash paid during the current period for miscellaneous operating activities, net change during the reporting period in other assets or other liabilities).

role.label: Payments for Nuclear Fuel
role.documentation: Cash outflow associated with the purchase of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

role.negatedLabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
role.terseLabel: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
role.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activities classified as other.

role.negatedLabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
role.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

role.terseLabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
role.negatedTerseLabel: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
role.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

role.terseLabel: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
role.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
role.documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

role.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
role.documentation: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

role.terseLabel: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
role.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
role.documentation: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

role.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
role.documentation: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

role.negatedLabel: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
role.label: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
role.documentation: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

role.label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
role.documentation: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

role.terseLabel: Proceeds from Advance for and Contribution in Aid of Construction, Financing Activity
role.label: Proceeds from Advance for and Contribution in Aid of Construction, Financing Activity
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow from advance for and contribution in aid of construction, classified as financing activity.

role.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
role.documentation: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

role.verboseLabel: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
role.label: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
role.documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

role.terseLabel: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
role.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

role.label: Proceeds From Issuance Of [Abstract]
role.documentation: Proceeds From Issuance Of.

role.negatedTerseLabel: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
role.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-Term Debt
role.documentation: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

role.label: Proceeds from Nuclear Fuel
role.documentation: Cash inflow resulting from the sale of any material that is commonly used in the generation of nuclear energy.

role.verboseLabel: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
role.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
role.documentation: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities classified as other.

role.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-Term Debt
role.documentation: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

role.terseLabel: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
role.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
role.documentation: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

role.terseLabel: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
role.label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
role.documentation: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

role.terseLabel: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
role.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
role.documentation: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

role.terseLabel: Proceeds received by storm trusts related to securitization
role.label: Proceeds received by storm trusts related to securitization
role.documentation: Proceeds received by storm trusts related to securitization

role.totalLabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Total

role.terseLabel: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
role.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
role.documentation: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

role.label: Provision for Other Losses
role.documentation: Amount of expense related to other loss.

role.documentation: Information by type of regulatory asset.

role.label: Regulatory Liability [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by type of regulatory liability.

role.label: Repayments of Long-Term Debt
role.documentation: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

role.label: Retained Earnings [Member]
role.documentation: Accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

role.label: Segments [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by business segments.

role.label: Class of Stock [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by the different classes of stock of the entity.

role.label: Equity Components [Axis]
role.documentation: Information by component of equity.

role.documentation: Line items represent financial concepts included in a table. These concepts are used to disclose reportable information associated with domain members defined in one or many axes to the table.

role.documentation: Disclosure of information about statement of comprehensive income, income, other comprehensive income, financial position, cash flows, and shareholders' equity.
